mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exception_case ( exception_key, exception_type, severity, status, validation_run_id, contract_id, agent_id, policy_version_id, source_entity_type, source_entity_id, title, description ) VALUES ( #{exceptionKey}, #{exceptionType}, #{severity}, 'NEW', #{validationRunId}, #{contractId}, #{agentId}, #{policyVersionId}, 'COMMISSION_TRANSACTION', CAST(#{paymentId} AS varchar), #{title}, #{description} ) ON CONFLICT (exception_key) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE exception_case.status IN ('NEW', 'IN_REVIEW')
